propositions: reconcile_check.py performs vendor-shape comparisons using direct adapters/jira imports and by-path sibling loads, violating backend-neutrality principle and creating a second vendor reach-through exemption
Assignee, description, and status/priority comparisons rely on raw Jira-specific extraction (_assignee_matches, _extract_jira_field, adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit) instead of canonical backend mappings
The by-path loader pattern (_load_sibling with adapters/jira/ literals) cannot be caught by existing AST import detection, requiring both AST and source-text validation cases in the neutrality gate

Canonicalizing via InboundMapper and OutboundMapper (reusing 625b's proven differ machinery) eliminates vendor reach-through while preserving report shape and enabling correct annotation-label precedence during comparison

Description comparison must use OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote with rstrip tolerance (mirroring the differ's _text_matches rule), not FieldSanitizer.sanitize_description which emits warnings inappropriately for a read-only diagnostic
